en.headline: MTR fixes signal fault near Ho Man Tin after brief Kwun Tong Line delays
en.dek: The MTR Corporation said trains slowed past a signalling equipment failure near Ho Man Tin Station around 9am, adding 10 to 15 minutes to journeys before service returned to normal.
body: The MTR Corporation said a signalling equipment fault near Ho Man Tin Station caused trains on the Kwun Tong Line to proceed slowly on Monday morning.

According to the operator, the fault was reported at about 9.02am. Overall journey times from terminus to terminus were expected to take an additional 10 to 15 minutes while staff worked on the problem.

The disruption lasted about 10 minutes. MTR staff resolved the issue and Kwun Tong Line services gradually returned to normal. Passengers were advised to allow extra time during the brief period of delay.

zh.headline: 何文田站附近信號故障 觀塘綫一度需額外10至15分鐘
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，周一早上約9時何文田站附近信號設備故障，列車需慢駛，觀塘綫行車時間一度增加10至15分鐘，約10分鐘後恢復正常。
body: 港鐵公司表示，何文田站附近出現信號設備故障，周一早上觀塘綫列車行經該路段需要慢駛。
港鐵指，故障於早上約9時02分報告。總站至總站的整體行車時間預計需額外10至15分鐘，期間人員正在處理。
事故維持約10分鐘。港鐵人員處理後，觀塘綫列車服務陸續恢復正常。港鐵提醒乘客在短暫延誤期間預留充裕時間。
